physical_limits: CA safeguards do not replace all-atom clashes, rotamers, hydrogen bonds, protonation or disulfide checks.

construct_policy.starting_preference: Biologically justified untrimmed constructs; do not inherit truncations merely because a successful source recipe used them.
construct_policy.trimming_exception: Consider only when structural evidence implicates a specific region in interference despite principled guidance, with explicit mapping and compatible comparison.
construct_policy.recipe_transfer: Transfer supported scoring modules separately from construct choices. The preferred historical trimmed recipe does not imply trimming is necessary.
